ext_name.message: PrimeVocab - Dual Subtitle & Spaced Repetition Vocabulary

ext_desc.message: Dual subtitles, smart auto-pause, and spaced repetition (SRS) vocabulary learning on Amazon Prime Video, Netflix, and YouTube.

empty_state_title.message: You haven't saved any words yet.

empty_state_help.message: Click on words in the subtitles while watching Prime Video to add them to your list.

confirm_clear_all.message: Are you sure you want to delete all saved words?

hint_word_click.message: Click a word to view translation and save it

sub_session_saved_words.message: You saved {count} new words in this video

settings_show_quick_access_help.message: Displays a semi-transparent icon on the video player to open the panel when closed. Clicking it opens the panel.

empty_archive_help.message: Click words in subtitles to add them to your dictionary

srs_settings_new_limit_help.message: Even if you have many words in your dictionary, at most this many new cards will appear daily. Due cards are not included in this limit.

srs_settings_session_limit_help.message: Maximum cards per session. Once reached, the session ends. Remaining cards do not carry over to tomorrow.

srs_new_cards_done.message: Today's new cards limit reached. Continue tomorrow!

settings_dual_sub_help.message: If two different subtitle tracks are loaded (e.g. English + Turkish), it reads the second automatically. Otherwise, it uses Google Translate.

settings_highlight_idioms_help.message: Automatically detects and highlights common idioms and collocations (e.g. piece of cake, under the weather) in subtitles.

settings_shadowing_help.message: Video pauses at the end of each subtitle line. Continue with Space.

settings_shadowing_smart_help.message: Smart: only pauses on sentences containing C1/C2-level vocabulary, words marked as hard, idioms, or phrasal verbs.

settings_auto_rewind_help.message: Video rewinds when a word is saved.

settings_auto_slow_mo_help.message: Automatically slows down video playback when subtitles contain saved words from the selected levels.

settings_yt_smart_note.message: On YouTube, these features only work with original (human-made) subtitles. They are disabled for auto-generated (ASR) captions.

settings_yt_asr_warning.message: Warning: This option may lead to unstable playback, constant pauses, or incorrect rewinds.

settings_hide_imdb_help.message: Hides X-Ray player list and dimming overlay.

settings_cinema_help.message: Hides all UI overlays, showing only subtitles on the video screen.

settings_prime_domain_help.message: Choose the default domain to open Prime Video links from the dictionary. Useful for routing links to your local regional Amazon store.

settings_reset_srs_help.message: Words will not be deleted, only study history (interval, review count, difficulty) will be reset.

settings_reset_srs_confirm.message: Your SRS progress will be reset. Words will not be deleted. Continue?

settings_anki_export_help.message: Download your saved words, translations, and context sentences in a format compatible with Anki.

settings_platforms_help.message: Choose which video platforms the extension should run on.

onboarding_welcome_desc.message: PrimeVocab is a smart assistant designed to help you learn vocabulary while watching videos. Let's learn the key features in 1 minute!

onboarding_subtitles_desc.message: Click on any word in the subtitles while watching a video to instantly translate it and save it to your dictionary with a single click.

onboarding_dictionary_desc.message: Saved words are automatically clustered by show, movie, and season. You can search, add custom tags, and filter words by CEFR levels.

onboarding_review_desc.message: Review words right before you forget them using scientific spaced repetition (SM-2), and track your learning streak with the activity heatmap.

onboarding_games_desc.message: Reinforce your vocabulary with 6 different interactive games like multiple choice, fill in the blanks, scramble, and dictation, while earning XP!

onboarding_shortcuts_desc.message: Use your Numpad or custom keys to navigate between words and save them quickly while the video is paused.

onboarding_profile_desc.message: Connect your Google account to back up words to the cloud; track your study streaks, XP, and earned level badges here.

onboarding_settings_desc.message: Customize subtitle appearance, auto slow-motion, Google Drive cloud sync, and keyboard shortcuts from the top menu drawer.

info_desc.message: PrimeVocab is an intelligent extension that lets you learn languages using dual subtitles and spaced repetition while watching videos.

profile_no_achievements.message: No achievements earned yet. Keep learning words!

archive_csv_backup_warning.message:
Words exported in CSV format cannot be directly imported back to the app. This is not a backup mechanism.

For a full backup, please use the 'Backup' option in settings or synchronize your account.

Do you want to proceed and download the CSV?

premium_welcome_desc.message: Welcome to PrimeVocab Premium! All limits are unlocked and your perks are active:

premium_feat_limit.message: The 50-word free limit is removed. Save as many words as you want.

premium_feat_sync.message: Automatically sync your vocabulary and streak progress across all devices.

premium_feat_practice.message: Study flashcards with no daily review limits using spaced repetition.

premium_feat_games.message: Access all 6 vocabulary mini-games and full learning vault.

premium_feat_export.message: Export all saved words directly to Anki deck or JSON backup format.

archive_inactive_badge_title.message: Not scanned in subtitles because it is outside the free version limit (Last 50 words).

premium_sync_required_desc.message: Your Google account is connected, but you need a Premium membership to use cloud synchronization.

premium_dual_sub_desc.message: Upgrade to Premium to display both learning and native subtitles simultaneously with Dual Subtitles.

premium_shadowing_desc.message: Upgrade to Premium to activate Shadowing mode for automated subtitle pauses and speaking practice.

premium_auto_rewind_desc.message: Upgrade to Premium to enable Auto Rewind and replay video context whenever you save a new word.

premium_auto_slow_mo_desc.message: Upgrade to Premium to enable Smart Slow-Mo, automatically slowing down playback on challenging vocabulary.

premium_word_family_desc.message: Upgrade to Premium to explore word families and morphological roots for deeper vocabulary mastery.
